test_address_scope: Public-classified IPv4/IPv6 addresses assigned only to loopback inside the private research-service network namespace; no Internet traffic
guest_observations: IPv4 public DNS phase: CONNECT 200 and exact public-canary-4 payload
Same IPv4 name after DNS change to loopback: CONNECT 403
IPv6 public DNS phase: CONNECT 200 and exact public-canary-6 payload
Same IPv6 name after DNS change to loopback: CONNECT 403
limitations: Authoritative UDP fixture with zero-TTL responses; no recursive resolver, cache or DNSSEC coverage
Tests changes between consecutive requests, not every intra-request race or CNAME/mixed-answer scenario
Private targets are reachable service-namespace loopback canaries, not a live LAN/VPN
Public-address payload is plain TCP behind CONNECT; no TLS/redirect/account capability claim
No real subscription credential, model request or provider endpoint
Lab controller remains private and not production packaged; companion fixtures require that harness
